entries.name: BO1 Zombies · community
entries.detail: Community browser Zombies maps. A fan project, separate from the official Black Ops release.

entries.name: Moon Zombies
entries.detail: Community Zombies recreation set on the Moon. Opens on the project website.

entries.name: Kino der Toten · community
entries.detail: Community browser Zombies survival. A recreation, not an official Call of Duty release.

entries.name: Cheese Cube · Zombies
entries.detail: Community recreation of a BO3 custom Zombies map, with browser solo and multiplayer options.

entries.name: Vibe Slops II · BO2-inspired
entries.detail: Claude of Duty: Vibe Slops II is a community browser FPS using a BO2 map export. It is not the full official Black Ops 2 game.

entries.name: Modern Warfare 2 · community link
entries.detail: User-supplied browser-game link. The site was rate-limited during review; its identity, requirements and gameplay remain unverified.

entries.name: Skate 3 · fan project
entries.detail: Unofficial fan project. Bring your own converted Skate 3 game copy; the website handles setup.

entries.name: Skate × Rust · community
entries.detail: Community browser skating game with private-session and bot options. Linked from the project website.

entries.name: Surfd
entries.detail: Source-style browser surfing with keyboard and mouse controls.

entries.name: Halo CE · community port
entries.detail: Independent browser port. Bring your own Halo Xbox XISO; the project does not provide game data.

entries.name: Halo CE Mobile · community port
entries.detail: Unofficial browser port with mobile controls. Bring your own Halo Xbox disc image; no game data is included.

entries.name: PES6 Web Online · community
entries.detail: Community PSP PES6 browser port with controller, touch and online controls. Unaffiliated with Konami.

entries.name: Vice City · community port
entries.detail: Bring your own game files. This community browser port is unaffiliated with Rockstar Games.

entries.name: The Simpsons: Hit & Run · community
entries.detail: Community WebAssembly entry. The site controls game setup and data; gameplay and file requirements remain unverified.

entries.name: QuakeWorld · multiplayer
entries.detail: Unofficial browser QuakeWorld multiplayer preservation project. This is not a complete single-player campaign.

entries.name: Quake II · multiplayer
entries.detail: Unofficial browser Quake II multiplayer preservation project.

entries.name: Quake III Arena · multiplayer
entries.detail: Unofficial Quake III browser multiplayer project with desktop, mobile and gamepad controls.

entries.name: Return to Castle Wolfenstein · multiplayer
entries.detail: Unofficial iortcw browser multiplayer port. The site reports an approximately 380 MB first load and recommends desktop Chrome.

entries.name: Urban Terror · multiplayer
entries.detail: Unofficial Urban Terror browser multiplayer preservation. This link is Urban Terror, not Unreal Tournament.

entries.name: Half-Life · Xash3D browser port
entries.detail: Community Xash3D FWGS browser port with local game-data ZIP input. Bring your own game files.

entries.name: Half-Life / CS 1.6 · WebXash
entries.detail: Bring your own Valve or cstrike game folders for the full games. The site also offers demo packages.

entries.name: Diablo · browser port
entries.detail: Community Diablo browser port. Shareware is available; the full game requires your own DIABDAT.MPQ.

entries.name: Hedgewars · community link
entries.detail: User-supplied link. HTTPS certificate validation failed during review; current availability and gameplay are unverified.

entries.name: WASM Arcade · game collection
entries.detail: Browse a community archive of browser ports, including GTA, Minecraft and other games. Requirements vary by title.

entries.name: Hextris
entries.detail: Original Hextris puzzle game. Its HTTPS certificate had expired during this review; current availability is unverified.
The tile puzzle on its original creator’s website.
